fact: On 3 September 2025 the FCCPC announced the gazetting and commencement (effective 21 July 2025) of the DEON consumer lending regulations, with redress mechanisms and sanctions of up to N100 million or 1 per cent of turnover.
title: DIGITAL LENDING: FCCPC TACKLES ABUSES, ISSUES LANDMARK REGULATIONS
publisher: Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Commission
